name: Scarab of Protection
summary: A medallion that improves your AC, grants Advantage against spells, and turns failed saves against necromancy into successes.

stats.effect:
This beetle-shaped medallion provides three benefits while it is on your person.

***Defense.*** You gain a +1 bonus to {ref:glossary/armor-class}.

***Preservation.*** The scarab has 12 charges. If you fail a saving throw against a Necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an Undead, you can take a {ref:glossary/reaction} to expend 1 charge and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last charge is expended.

***Spell Resistance.*** You have {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells.
